name: Shoot
description:
You throw your Orb at a creature within its range. Roll Dexterity vs Defense. On a hit, the Orb deals 1d4+BODY base damage, plus an additional 1d4 for each charge it contains. The charges are expended, and the orb magically returns to you, propelled by its own magic force.

On a miss, it deals no damage, retains and charges it contains, and falls to the ground in a space adjacent to the target (GM's choice). You must either move to retrieve it or use a half action to recall the orb to magically to you.
